title: Open Letter to Parents, Guardians, and Caregivers
body_1: Over the course of the last few years, the FBI has observed a concerning increase in activity by online actors involved in predatory activity. These predators target children across the United States, including in Wisconsin.

title: Operation Spring Cleaning: Over 40 Arrests in Coordinated Multi-Agency Crackdown on Violent Crimes in North Alabama
body_1: On April 15 and 16, 2026, more than 50 federal, state, and local law enforcement officers collaborated to arrest 40 individuals involved in violent crimes.

title: Columbia, Missouri Doctor Arrested, Accused of Health Care Fraud, Illegally Prescribing Drugs
body_1: A medical doctor and owner of an urgent care clinic in Columbia, Missouri, was arrested on an indictment that accuses him of defrauding Medicare and Medicaid.

title: Federal Grand Jury Charges Southern Poverty Law Center for Wire Fraud, False Statements, and Conspiracy to Commit Money Laundering
body_1: A grand jury in Montgomery, Alabama, returned an indictment charging the Southern Poverty Law Center with 11 counts of wire fraud, false statements to a federally insured bank, and conspiracy to commit concealment money laundering.

title: Leader of Chicago Street Gang Sentenced to Life in Prison for Participating in Racketeering Conspiracy Involving Multiple Murders
body_1: A leader of the Four Corner Hustlers street gang in Chicago has been sentenced to life in federal prison for participating in a criminal organization that terrorized the West Side of Chicago.

title: Convicted Sex Offender Receives Multiple Life Sentences in Prison
body_1: A convicted sex offender, Graham Daniel Ash, will serve life in prison for the sexual exploitation and sexual abuse of numerous children across the U.S.

title: Buffalo Man Pleads Guilty to COVID Fraud
body_1: Jamar Jackson, 43, of Buffalo, New York, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud, which carries a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison, and a fine of $250,000.

title: FBI Chicago Announces Reward of Up to $50,000 for Information Leading to Arrest and Conviction of Joseph “Troubles” Matos
body_1: Douglas S. DePodesta, special agent in charge of the Chicago Division of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), announced a reward of up to $50,000 for information leading to the arrest and conviction of Joseph “Troubles” Matos.

title: MS-13 Members Sentenced to Decades in Federal Prison for Brutal Murders Committed at Direction of Gang Leaders in El Salvador
body_1: Eight illegal aliens and members of the transnational criminal organization known as MS-13 have been sentenced for participating in a racketeering conspiracy.

title: Hard Money Lender Pleads Guilty to Defrauding Investors in Two Cases Involving Bitwise Industries and Voyager Pacific Capital Management Totaling $45 Million in Losses
body_1: David Hardcastle, 61, of Fresno, pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud in two separate cases that resulted in a combined loss of approximately $45 million.

title: New Orleans Man Guilty of Drug Trafficking and Possession of Gun in Furtherance of Drug Trafficking
body_1: Jadi’Kiss J’Had Williams pleaded guilty to possession with intent to distribute controlled substance and possession of a firearm in furtherance of a drug trafficking crime.

body_1: An Iranian national residing in the San Fernando Valley has been arrested on a federal criminal complaint charging her with selling Iranian-made weapons to Sudan.

title: Canyon Country Man Pleads Guilty to Federal Charges, Including Facilitating Crime Tourism Group That Burgled Its Way Through U.S.
body_1: A Santa Clarita Valley man pleaded guilty to federal criminal charges, including facilitating a crime tourism group of South Americans and other individuals who committed burglaries and other crimes throughout the U.S.

title: Former Soldier Convicted of Physically and Sexually Assaulting Minors While Serving Abroad
body_1: Following a four-day trial, a federal jury convicted an Atlanta man, Adam Schlueter, of sexually and physically abusing two minors while he was stationed overseas with the U.S. Army.

title: Prior Felon Arrested on Gun Charge
body_1: Earl Stone of Buffalo, New York, has been charged by criminal complaint with being a felon in possession of a firearm, which carries a maximum penalty of 15 years in prison.

title: FBI Jacksonville Warns Public to Beware of Scammers Impersonating FBI Special Agents in North Florida
body_1: The FBI Jacksonville Field Office is warning the public about schemes in which scammers impersonate law enforcement or government officials, including FBI special agents, in attempts to extort money or steal personally identifiable information.

title: Wilmington Man Indicted After Machinegun and Manifesto Are Found
body_1: A federal jury returned an indictment charging a Wilmington, Delaware, man for unlawfully possessing a Glock 19 equipped with a machinegun conversion device.

title: Kauai Man Sentenced to Federal Prison and Ordered to Repay $1.4 Million for Stealing From Federal COVID-19 Relief Program
body_1: Ethan Page, 52, of Kekaha, Hawaii, was sentenced to 14 months in prison following his guilty plea for making a false statement to the Small Business Administration.

title: British National Pleads Guilty to Hacking Into Companies and Stealing at Least $8 Million in Virtual Currency
body_1: A United Kingdom man pleaded guilty to conspiring with others to hack into the computer systems of at least a dozen companies via text message phishing attacks.

title: Chicago Man Sentenced to 25 Years in Prison for Conspiring to Provide Material Support to Foreign Terrorist Organization
body_1: Ashraf Al Safoo, a leader of Khattab Media Foundation, has been sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for conspiring to provide material support to the Islamic State of Iraq and al-Sham (ISIS).

title: District of Arizona Charges 240 Individuals for Immigration-Related Criminal Conduct This Week
body_1: During the week of enforcement operations from April 11 through April 17, 2026, the U.S. Attorney’s Office brought immigration-related criminal charges against 240 individuals.

title: Repeat Offender Sentenced to 15 Years for Drug Trafficking, Firearms Crimes
body_1: An Anchorage man was sentenced to 15 years in prison for committing drug trafficking and firearms crimes while on pretrial release in multiple state cases.

title: Irwin Resident Pleads Guilty to Distributing and Possessing Child Sexual Abuse Material
body_1: Kyle Patrick Ryan, 37, a resident of Irwin, Pennsylvania, pleaded guilty to charges of distribution and possession of material depicting the sexual exploitation of a minor.

title: New Jersey Pharmacy Owner Sentenced to 24 Months in Prison for Health Care Fraud Scheme
body_1: Nestor E. Jaime, a former New Jersey pharmacy owner, has been sentenced to 24 months in prison for his role in a health care fraud scheme to defraud Medicare.

title: High-Level Guatemalan Cocaine Trafficker Sentenced to 10 Years
body_1: Jorge Campos-Oliva, an extradited Guatemalan national, was sentenced to 10 years in federal prison on charges of international cocaine distribution conspiracy.

title: U.S. Attorney’s Office Filed 143 Border-Related Cases This Week
body_1: Federal prosecutors in the Southern District of California filed 143 border-related cases this week, including charges of bringing in aliens for financial gain.

title: Alien Drug Trafficker from Colombia Sentenced to Five Years’ Imprisonment
body_1: An illegal alien from Colombia was sentenced to 60 months’ imprisonment after he possessed and intended to distribute fentanyl in the District of Utah.

title: Egyptian National Sentenced for Federal Firearms Offense
body_1: An Egyptian national has been sentenced to 18 months in prison for illegally possessing a firearm after pointing a handgun at a victim at a Las Cruces gas station.

title: Texas Man Who Orchestrated $20 Million Cryptocurrency Scam Sentenced to 23 Years in Prison
body_1: A Texas man who orchestrated a cryptocurrency scam that bilked nearly 1,000 investors out of more than $20 million has been sentenced to 23 years in federal prison.

title: U.S. Authorities Conduct Cyber Operations as Part of Global Crackdown on DDoS-for-Hire Services
body_1: Officials announced court-authorized actions taken to disrupt some of the world’s leading Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) Internet of Things (IoT) botnet services.

title: Man Admits to Feloniously Using His Vehicle to Impede, Intimidate, and Interfere with the Work of Federal Immigration Agents During Operation Midway Blitz
body_1: A man has admitted in federal court that he used his vehicle to impede, intimidate, and interfere with the work of federal immigration agents during Operation Midway Blitz.

title: New Jersey Man Pleads Guilty to Scheme Designed to Obtain Fraudulent Visas to Bring Aliens to the U.S. for Unlawful Fundraising
body_1: A New Jersey man pleaded guilty to charges arising from a conspiracy to induce foreign nationals to come to the U.S. through fraudulently obtained visas.

title: Rochester Man Arrested, Charged with Production and Receipt of Child Pornography and Enticement of a Minor
body_1: Kenneth Tootle was arrested and charged by criminal complaint with production of child pornography, enticement of a minor, and receipt of child pornography.

title: New Castle Woman Sentenced to Two-and-a-Half Years in Prison for Fentanyl, Heroin, and Cocaine Trafficking
body_1: A resident of New Castle, Pennsylvania, has been sentenced on her conviction of violating federal drug trafficking laws as part of a Homeland Security Task Force prosecution.

title: Grand Jury Indicts Lockport Man on Charges of Enticement of a Minor and Production and Possession of Child Pornography
body_1: Damon Singleton-Spencer was charged with enticement of a minor, three counts of production of child pornography, and seven counts of possession of child pornography.

body_1: The FBI, FAA, Denver Police Department and Colorado Rockies want to remind everyone of the rules limiting drone use around Coors Field during game days.

body_1: An arrest warrant was issued for Emuobosan Emanuella Hall, age 45, of Atlanta, Georgia, for failure to report to the Bureau of Prisons to serve a sentence.

title: Six Charged in Sumter and Lee County Drug Trafficking Conspiracy

body_1: A chiropractor who committed health care fraud and issued fraudulent prescriptions for controlled substance has been sentenced to 100 months in prison.

body_1: Amanda Leigh Fourez, a resident of Catlin, Illinois, pleaded guilty in federal court to charges of conspiracy to create and distribute animal crush videos.

body_1: A former Baltimore City School police officer and Dunbar High School football coach are heading to prison in connection with wire fraud and tax evasion charges.

title: Longtime Bucks County Teacher Sentenced to Seven-and-a-Half Years in Prison for Child Pornography Offenses
body_1: A Warminster, Pennsylvania, teacher was sentenced to prison on one count of receipt and attempted receipt of child pornography and one count of possession of child pornography.

title: Attempted Carjacking at Suburban Chicago Gas Station Leads to Nearly Six-Year Prison Sentence
body_1: A man has been sentenced to nearly six years in federal prison for attempting to carjack a vehicle at gunpoint while the driver’s wife and children were inside.

title: New Hampshire Man Indicted for Cyberstalking and Child Sexual Exploitation
body_1: A Londonderry, New Haven, man was arrested for allegedly cyberstalking a Massachusetts victim through social media, text messages, and various online platforms.

title: FBI Seeks Potential Victims of Victor Daniel “Danny” Almaguer
body_1: The FBI’s Corpus Christi Resident Agency is seeking to identify potential victims of Victor Daniel “Danny” Almaguer, the owner of Danny’s Tires in Corpus Christi, Texas.

body_1: Anthony Mitchell of Haverstraw, New York, was sentenced to 135 months in prison for enticement and coercion of a minor spanning multiple years when the victim was 13 and 14 years old.

title: Florida Nursing Assistant Sentenced to Nine Years in Prison for $11.4 Million Health Care Fraud Scheme Targeting Medicare Beneficiaries
body_1: A Florida nursing assistant was sentenced to nine years in prison and two years of supervised release for his role in an $11. million health care fraud and wire fraud conspiracy.

title: Sacramento Man Sentenced to 22 Years in Prison for Fentanyl Pill Trafficking That Resulted in an Overdose Death
body_1: Sandro Escobedo of Sacramento was sentenced for conspiracy to distribute and possess with intent to distribute fentanyl, cocaine, and methamphetamine, and distribution of fentanyl.

title: High Museum of Art’s Former Chief Operating Officer Charged with Embezzlement
body_1: Brady Lum, the former chief operating officer of the High Museum of Art, was arraigned on a federal charge of theft concerning programs receiving federal funds.

body_1: The FBI is offering a reward for information leading to the identification, arrest, and conviction of the individual(s) responsible for the murder of Aliza Spencer.

title: Illegal Alien From El Salvador Charged with Assault on a Federal Officer with a Deadly Weapon
body_1: Carlos Ivan Mendoza Hernandez, 36, a national of El Salvador residing in Stanislaus County, was charged with assault on a federal officer with a deadly weapon.

title: Charlottesville Man Sentenced for Promoting Commercial Sex Ring
body_1: Brian Lamont Turner, 45, of Charlottesville, Virginia, has been sentenced to eight years in prison for posting hundreds of online advertisements for commercial sex.

title: Fugitive KaShawn Roper, Wanted for Second Degree Homicide, Added to the FBI’s List of Ten Most Wanted Fugitives
body_1: The FBI, alongside the Kansas City Missouri Police Department and the Jackson County Prosecutor’s Office, announced the addition of KaShawn Nicola Roper to the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list and a $1 million reward leading to her arrest and conviction.

title: First Assistant U.S. Attorney, FBI SAC Warn Residents of Scam Calls
body_1: First Assistant U.S. Attorney Robert N. Tracci and Special Agent in Charge Ian Kaufmann, of the FBI’s Richmond Division, are warning residents of scam calls being made in the Western District of Virginia.

body_1: Lawrence Smith, 55, a resident of Fairfax, Virginia, was sentenced to 12 months in prison for his role in a large-scale cocaine distribution conspiracy.

body_1: Daniel Moreno-Gama, 20, of Spring, Texas, was charged federally with attempted damage and destruction of property by means of explosives and possession of an unregistered firearm.

title: Career Offender Sentenced to Over 22 Years in Federal Prison for Methamphetamine Trafficking and Firearms Offenses
body_1: Michael Wilson of Memphis was sentenced to over 22 years in federal prison for his role in engaging in a long-term conspiracy to distribute methamphetamine in Memphis, Tennessee.

title: Justice Department Announces Compensation Process for OneCoin Fraud Victims with Funds Recovered Through Asset Forfeiture
body_1: The Department of Justice announced the beginning of the remission compensation process to provide recovery for victims of an international investment scheme.

title: Former Loveland, Colorado, Police Department Officer Sentenced for Sexually Assaulting a Minor Child
body_1: Dylan Miller, 30, a former Loveland, Colorado, Police Department (LPD) officer, was sentenced to 17 years in prison for sexually assaulting a minor while he was on duty.

title: Quemado Man Pleads Guilty to Federal Firearm Offense
body_1: Chad Walter Gash, 43, of Quemado, pleaded guilty in federal court after law enforcement seized 13 firearms and ammunition from his property during a 2024 search.

title: Veterinarian Arrested for Sending Threatening Text Message and Transporting Minors in Interstate Commerce with the Intent to Engage in Sexual Acts
body_1: Gregory Ford of Morriston has been arrested on charges of transporting a minor with the intent to engage in sexual activity and sending threatening communications.

title: Butler Man Pleads Guilty to Threatening to Assault and Murder President Trump, Other U.S. Officials, and Immigration and Customs Enforcement Agents
body_1: Shawn Monper, 33, a resident of Butler, Pennsylvania, pleaded guilty in federal court to making threats to assault and murder President Donald J. Trump, other United States officials.

title: Graduate Student From Colorado Indicted for Sexual Exploitation of Minors and Cyberstalking
body_1: Chandan M. Bhangale, age 29, has been charged with two counts of attempted sexual exploitation of minors from the Fox Valley region and one count of cyberstalking.

title: California Man Pleads Guilty to Stalking, Harassing, and Threatening Women in Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Elsewhere
body_1: Justin Glauthier, 30, of California, has pleaded guilty in federal court in Rhode Island to charges related to a scheme in which he made hundreds of obscene and threatening telephone calls.

title: Illegal Alien Sentenced to 13 Years in Prison for Child Pornography Offense and Illegal Reentry
body_1: A Guatemalan national unlawfully residing in Dorchester, Massachusetts, has been sentenced to 13 years in prison for unlawfully reentering the United States.

title: Rowan County Man Sentenced for Methamphetamine and Fentanyl Trafficking
body_1: Corey Skiles, 34, of Morehead, received 160 months in prison for possession with intent to distribute 500 grams of methamphetamine and 40 grams or more of fentanyl.

title: DC Solar Accountant is Last to Be Sentenced for the DC Solar Billion-Dollar Ponzi Scheme
body_1: Ronald J. Roach, 59, the last defendant in the biggest criminal fraud scheme in the history of the Eastern District of California, was sentenced to 66 months in prison.

title: Farmington Man Pleads Guilty to Federal Firearms Charge After Armed Carjacking
body_1: Myles Cordelle Dan Padilla, 34, of Farmington, has pleaded guilty to federal firearms offenses following a 2022-armed carjacking in which he discharged a weapon.

title: Farmington Woman Sentenced for Assault on Motorcyclist
body_1: Tenille Quintawna Peshlakai, 33, of Farmington has been sentenced to five years of probation for intentionally causing a motorcyclist to crash following an argument.

title: IU Biology Researcher Pleads Guilty to Smuggling E. coli DNA From China Concealed in Clothing Shipment
body_1: Youhuang Xiang, 32, formerly a post-doctoral researcher at Indiana University and a citizen of the People’s Republic of China, has been sentenced to more than four months in prison for smuggling biologic materials into the U.S.

title: Two Illegal Aliens From Mexico Sentenced to Decades in Federal Prison for Drug Trafficking in West Tennessee
body_1: Brothers, Julio Cesar Garcia, 45, and Juan Carlos Garcia, 41, both of Chiapas, Mexico, were sentenced to prison for conspiracy to possess with intent to distribute methamphetamine.

title: Inland Empire Man Federally Charged with Deliberately Setting Fires That Destroyed Massive Warehouse in Ontario
body_1: Chamel Abdulkarim, 29, of Highland, has been charged in a federal criminal complaint with deliberately setting fires that destroyed a 1. million-square-foot warehouse.

title: U.S. Attorney’s Office Filed 111 Border-Related Cases This Week
body_1: Federal prosecutors filed 111 border-related cases this week, including charges of bringing in aliens for financial gain, reentering the U.S. after deportation, and importation of controlled substances.

title: Man Sentenced to 10 Years for Carjacking a Cabdriver at Gunpoint
body_1: Manuel Joseph Rose III of San Diego was sentenced to 10 years in prison for committing an armed carjacking and unlawfully possessing ammunition as a convicted felon.

title: District of Arizona Charges 171 Individuals for Immigration-Related Criminal Conduct This Week
body_1: During the week of enforcement operations from April 4 through April 10, 2026, the U.S. Attorney’s Office brought immigration-related criminal charges against 171 individuals.

title: Asian Boyz Gang Member and Second Gang Associate From Lowell Plead Guilty to Methamphetamine Pill Trafficking Conspiracy
body_1: Two Lowell men with allegiances to the Asian Boyz gang have pleaded guilty to distributing and conspiring to distribute thousands of counterfeit Adderall pills.

title: Man Pleads Guilty to Suborning Perjury in Federal Court
body_1: During the second week of his federal trial on several witness tampering and perjury charges, Omar R. Pouncy, 38, of Flint, pleaded guilty to suborning perjury.

title: Three Family Members Plead Guilty to Smuggling Drugs Into Prison

title: Member of the Lynn Chapter of the Trinitarios Pleads Guilty to Racketeering Conspiracy
body_1: A member of the Lynn Chapter of the Trinitarios pleaded guilty to racketeering charges, including his participation in two murders and two other attempted murders.

title: Retired Massachusetts State Police Sergeant Agrees to Plead Guilty to PPP Fraud
body_1: A retired Sergeant for the Massachusetts State Police has been charged and has agreed to plead guilty to allegedly fraudulently obtaining a Paycheck Protection Program loan.

title: Two Sentenced to Over 46 Years for Drug Murder
body_1: Tsvia Kol, 37, of Hallandale, and Jimmy Sanchez, 38, of Spring Valley, California, have been sentenced to prison for the 2022 killing of a man in relation to a drug trafficking conspiracy.

title: Former Ohkay Owingeh Police Officer Pleads Guilty to Obstruction of Justice
body_1: A former Ohkay Owingeh Police Department officer has pleaded guilty to using his position to disclose sensitive information about a federal investigation.

title: Webster Man Pleads Guilty to Building and Detonating Pipe Bombs in Weare
body_1: Dale G. Stewart, Jr., 57, of Webster, pleaded guilty in federal court to three counts of possessing an unregistered firearm, specifically a destructive device.

title: Alabama Man Sentenced to Eight Years in Federal Prison for Leadership Role in Alien Smuggling Organization
body_1: Joel Contreras Jr., 33, of Albertville, Alabama, was sentenced in Del Rio to 96 months in prison for conspiracy to transport illegal aliens, placing lives in jeopardy.

title: Border Enforcement Efforts Result in Another 354 People Charged in SDTX
body_1: In support of Operation Take Back America, the Southern District of Texas has filed another 353 cases in immigration and border-security related matters.

title: Former Shallowater ISD Assistant Band Director Indicted for Enticement of a Minor
body_1: A former Shallowater ISD assistant band director was indicted for enticement of a minor after engaging in a sexual relationship with a female high school student.

title: South Carolinians Lose $264 Million to Cybercrime, According to Newly Released 2025 Annual IC3 Report
body_1: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC) has released its 2025 annual report. South Carolina ranked 21st of all states and territories in the number of complaints reported by the public, as well as in the separate 2025 elder fraud report.

title: FBI Atlanta, Indonesian Authorities Take Down Global Phishing Network Behind Millions in Fraud Attempts
body_1: In a first-of-its-kind joint cyber investigation, the FBI Atlanta Field Office and Indonesian law enforcement authorities have dismantled a sophisticated global phishing operation that enabled cybercriminals to steal thousands of victims’ account credentials and attempt more than $20 million in fraud.

title: Former FBI Most Wanted Fugitive Admits Child Sex Trafficking
body_1: Donald Eugene Fields II, who was once on the FBI’s Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list, pleaded guilty to providing sexual access to a child in exchange for cash and other items of value.

title: Muskogee Resident Sentenced for Assault Resulting in Serious Bodily Injury
body_1: Tommy Lynn Byrd, Jr., age 38, of Muskogee, Oklahoma, was sentenced to 33 months in prison for one count of assault resulting in serious bodily injury in Indian Country.

body_1: Jonathan Leissler, of Stow, Ohio, who embezzled millions from his employer and a local fraternal police organization, has been sentenced to 48 months in prison.

title: Three Crips Members Convicted of Racketeering, Murder, and Other Gang-Related Crimes
body_1: Three gang members were convicted on 52 counts of a third superseding indictment charging them variously with racketeering, racketeering conspiracy, murder, and related crimes.

title: Tennessee Man Who Was Found in Florida with Missing Ohio Teen Charged with Transporting a Minor to Engage in Sexual Activity
body_1: Charges have been filed in the Southern District of Ohio against a Tennessee man with whom a previously missing Colerain teenager was found in Florida on March 13.

title: Clearwater Man Sentenced to More Than Seven Years in Prison for Distributing and Possessing Child Sexual Abuse Material
body_1: Zachary William Thomas has been sentenced to seven years and six months in federal prison for distribution and possession of child sexual abuse material (CSAM).

title: Memphis Resident Sentenced for Federal Kidnapping
body_1: Elmer Smith, 39, of Memphis, Tennessee, pleaded guilty and was sentenced to over 14 years in prison for kidnapping a victim as a result of domestic violence.

body_1: Shauntel Shangreaux, 32, of Pine Ridge, South Dakota, has been sentenced to 19 years and two months in prison for conspiracy to distribute a controlled substance.

title: Faith, South Dakota, Man Found Guilty After Trial of First-Degree Burglary
body_1: Dalton Hump, age 34, of Faith, South Dakota, was convicted of first-degree burglary following a two-day jury trial in federal district court in Pierre, South Dakota.

title: Two More Defendants Plead Guilty in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
body_1: Two more defendants—Suleman Yusuf Mohamed and his brother Gandi Yusuf Mohamed—have pleaded guilty for their roles in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.

title: Career Offender Sentenced to 20 Years in Prison for Federal Drug and Firearms Charges
body_1: A Richmond drug trafficker, Montrio Santos Neville, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison following his conviction for possession of a firearm by a convicted felon.

title: Cuban Man Sentenced for Cocaine Distribution Conspiracy, Possession with Intent to Distribute
body_1: Yaidel Placido Salvador, a resident of Cuba, was sentenced after pleading guilty to an indictment charging him with conspiracy to distribute five kilograms or more of cocaine.

title: Cocaine Dealer and Repeat Immigration Offender Sentenced to Federal Prison

title: Love County Resident Sentenced for Possessing Child Sexual Exploitation Material

title: Billings Man Sentenced to Five Years in Prison for Sexual Abuse on the Crow Indian Reservation
body_1: A Billings man who sexually assaulted a child on the Crow Indian Reservation was sentenced to 60 months in prison to be followed by 10 years of supervised release.

title: Johnstown Resident Sentenced to 12 Years in Prison for Drug Trafficking
body_1: A resident of Johnstown, Pennsylvania, was sentenced on his convictions of conspiracy to distribute and possession with intent to distribute methamphetamine, fentanyl, heroin, cocaine, and crack.

title: Former Executive of Chicago-Area Nonprofit Sentenced to Prison for $1.9 Million Fraud Schemes
body_1: A former executive of a Chicago-area non-profit organization has been sentenced to a year in federal prison for misappropriating nearly $1. million through a pair of fraud schemes.

title: Former Army Employee and Top Secret Clearance Holder Arrested and Charged with Leaking Classified National Defense Information
body_1: After the FBI arrested Courtney Williams, a federal grand jury indicted her in connection with her alleged transmission of classified national defense information.

title: Wilkinsburg Resident Sentenced Following Guilty Plea for Stealing From Another Passenger During Flight
body_1: A resident of Wilkinsburg, Pennsylvania, pleaded guilty to a charge of theft on an aircraft and was sentenced to one year of supervised release, including 90 days of home detention.

body_1: FBI Milwaukee and the West Milwaukee Police Department are asking for the public’s help in identifying and locating a man who robbed a bank earlier this year.

title: District Resident Charged with Producing Child Pornography

title: Outlaw Motorcycle Gang Member Sentenced for Armed Assault Against Rival

title: Justice Department Conducts Court-Authorized Disruption of DNS Hijacking Network Controlled by a Russian Military Intelligence Unit
body_1: The Department of Justice and the FBI announced a court-authorized technical operation to neutralize the U.S. portion of a network of small office/home office (SOHO) routers compromised by a unit within Russia’s Main Intelligence Directorate of the General Staff (GRU) Military Unit 26165, also known as APT, Sofacy Group, Forest Blizzard, Pawn Storm, Fancy Bear, and Sednit.

title: Iranian-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit Programmable Logic Controllers Across U.S. Critical Infrastructure

body_1: A former Orange County resident was sentenced to 84 months in prison for threatening to kill a superior court judge who had presided over his family law case.

title: Former CFO Sentenced to Two Years in Prison for $35 Million Theft From Start-Up Tech Firm
body_1: A Mercer Island, Washington, man was sentenced to two years in prison for four counts of wire fraud for taking and misusing $35 million from his former employer.

title: Dark Web Fentanyl Distributor Sentenced to 42 Months in Prison
body_1: Trevor Stephen Haahr, 34, of Puyallup, Washington, was sentenced to 42 months in prison for operating a ‘dark web’ marketplace selling fentanyl tainted pills.

title: Russian Citizen Charged with Laundering Over $1.2M Connected to $400M in Fraudulent Medicare Claims
body_1: A Russian national made his initial appearance in Houston, Texas, on a charge that he laundered over $1. million derived from a health care fraud scheme.

title: Former Carlyle Police Chief Accused of Embezzling More Than $100,000
body_1: The former police chief of the Carlyle Police Department is facing several federal charges for allegedly embezzling more than $100,000 for his personal benefit.

title: Owner of Chicago-Area Convenience Stores Sentenced to Four Years in Prison for Defrauding Low-Income Food Program
body_1: A federal judge has sentenced the owner of several Chicago-area convenience stores to four years in prison for scheming to defraud a low-income food program.

title: Schenectady Man Pleads Guilty to Distribution and Possession of Child Pornography
body_1: Gregory Magin, age 45, of Glenville, New York, pleaded guilty to one count each of distribution of child pornography and possession of child pornography.

title: FCI Aliceville Correctional Officer Indicted for Sexual Assault of Inmates
body_1: A correctional officer at FCI Aliceville was charged in an indictment with eight counts of deprivation of rights under color law arising out of his sexual assault of seven female inmates.

title: D.C. Dentist and Hygienist Found Guilty in Scheme to Defraud D.C. Medicaid of $4 Million
body_1: Steven A. Price, 69, of the District of Columbia, and Keidi C. Moore, 39, of Temple Hills, Maryland, were found guilty of conspiring to defraud D.C. Medicaid of $4 million.

title: Former Gladwyne Entrepreneur Who Bilked Investors Out of Millions of Dollars Sentenced to Over Nine Years in Prison
body_1: Josh S. Verne was sentenced for a series of schemes through which he defrauded dozens of investors, prospective investors, employees, and business partners out of millions of dollars.

title: Philadelphia Correctional Officer and His Former Supervisor Convicted at Trial in Connection with Violation of Inmate’s Constitutional Rights
body_1: A correctional officer and his former supervisor were convicted at trial in connection with the violation of an inmate’s constitutional rights and an attempt to cover it up.

title: Wagoner Resident Sentenced for Assault Resulting in Serious Bodily Injury
body_1: Mark Justin Hall of Wagoner was sentenced for one count of assault resulting in substantial bodily injury to a spouse, intimate partner, and dating partner in Indian Country.

title: York County Man Sentenced to 30 Years in Prison for Production of Child Pornography and Enticement of a Minor to Engage in Illegal Sexual Activity
body_1: Jonah Allen Sassam Watt was sentenced to 30 years in federal prison for charges related to the production of child pornography and for his online enticement of minors.

title: Harrison County Man Indicted on Charges of Threatening the President and ICE
body_1: A Clarksburg, West Virginia, man has been federally charged with making threats against President Donald J. Trump and Immigrations and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents.

title: United States Leads Dismantlement of One of the World’s Largest Hacker Forums
body_1: The Department of Justice announced the seizure of the LeakBase database, one of the world’s largest online forums for cybercriminals to sell stolen data.

title: Lubbock Chapter President of the Bandidos Motorcycle Club Charged with Methamphetamine Distribution
body_1: Steven Glenn Ryals, president of the Bandidos Motorcycle Club, was charged for his role in possessing large quantities of methamphetamine for distribution.

title: Four Operation Mobile Order Defendants Sentenced to Prison
body_1: Four defendants were sentenced to prison after the FBI’s two-year Operation Mobile Order investigation uncovered their Macon-based armed drug trafficking network.

title: Farmington Resident Pleads Guilty to Distributing and Possessing Child Sexual Abuse Material
body_1: Nathan Fike, a resident of Farmington, Pennsylvania, pleaded guilty in federal court to charges of violating federal laws regarding the sexual exploitation of a minor.

title: Operation Winter SHIELD: FBI Philadelphia on Protecting the Transportation and Logistics
body_1: FBI Philadelphia is highlighting a different industry and the vital cybersecurity defenses they can utilize to protect themselves and the critical systems our communities rely on.

title: Kentucky Man Sentenced to Prison for Fentanyl Crime
body_1: Kody D. Harless, 28, of Tomahawk, Kentucky, was sentenced to eight years and 10 months in prison for possession with intent to distribute a quantity of fentanyl.

title: Jacksonville Marketing Company Owner Pleads Guilty to Conspiring to Defraud Medicare and Medicaid in the Provision of HIV Prophylactic Medications
body_1: Jonathan Simeon Gholston, 35, of Jacksonville, has pleaded guilty to conspiring to receive kickbacks in return for the referral of Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries.

title: Indiana Man Who Targeted a Local Christian Church for Vandalism Sentenced to Federal Prison
body_1: Steven James Perkinson, 21, of Plainfield, has been sentenced to 10 months in federal prison for the intentional damage to religious property and making a false statement to an agency of the United States.

title: Texas Man Sentenced for Monopolizing International Transit Industry, Fixing Prices, and Extorting Competitors
body_1: Roberto Garcia Villarreal of San Benito has been sentenced to prison and must pay a substantial fine for his role in a violent conspiracy to monopolize the transmigrante forwarding agency industry in the Los Indios border region near Harlingen and Brownsville.

title: Alleged Tren de Aragua Gang Members Charged in Connection with ATM Jackpotting Scheme
body_1: Two Venezuelan nationals, alleged to be members of the violent transnational criminal organization Tren De Aragua, have been charged in connection with an ATM jackpotting conspiracy.

title: Indictment Charges Investment Advisor with Defrauding Financial Services Companies of $3.3 Million
body_1: Andrew M. Komarow, 36, of Avon, was charged with offenses related to his alleged defrauding of three financial services companies of approximately $3. million.

title: Federal Jury Finds Former San Diego County Sheriff’s Deputy Guilty in Fatal Shooting of Unarmed Fleeing Arrestee
body_1: Former San Diego County Sheriff’s Deputy Aaron Richard Russell was convicted in the fatal shooting of a 36-year-old unarmed man who was shot four times.

title: Alleged Boss of Violent Sinaloa Cartel Indicted on Drug, Firearm, and Material Support of Terrorism Charges
body_1: A federal grand jury in Chicago has indicted an alleged boss of the violent Sinaloa Cartel in Mexico on drug, firearm, and material support of terrorism charges.

title: Tucson Man Who Shot at Air and Marine Operations Helicopter Indicted for Attempted Murder of a Federal Officer
body_1: A federal grand jury in Tucson returned a five-count indictment against Patrick Gary Schlegel, 34, of Tucson, Arizona, for violent crimes against a federal officer.

title: Springfield Man Sentenced to Over 12 Years in Prison for Federal Hate Crime Violation
body_1: A Springfield, Oregon, man was sentenced to federal prison for a federal hate crime after assaulting a victim on the basis of their sexual orientation.

title: Roanoke Man Sentenced for Possessing Child Sexual Exploitation Material
body_1: Christopher Allan Johnson of Roanoke, who used the Kik social media app to send three videos containing child sexual exploitation material, was sentenced to 40 months in prison.

title: Former Assistant Superintendent and Former IT Director of Patterson Joint Unified School District Sentenced to Prison for Stealing Approximately $1.5 Million in Embezzlement Scheme
body_1: Jeffrey Menge, of Copperopolis, and Eric Drabert, of Modesto, were sentenced to 30 months and 18 months in prison, respectively, for theft concerning programs receiving federal funds

title: Bond County Methamphetamine Dealer Sentenced to Federal Prison
body_1: A district court judge sentenced a Bond County man to 151 months in prison after he sold methamphetamine and engaged in a three-hour standoff with police.

title: Houston Man Gets 20 Years for Sex Trafficking Minor
body_1: Trevyeon Deshawn Prater of Houston has been ordered to federal prison after luring a minor away from her family and forcing her to engage in prostitution.

title: Defendant Charged with Damaging the Brooklyn Headquarters of the Chabad-Lubavitch Movement
body_1: Dan Sohail of Carteret, New Jersey, has been charged with intentionally damaging religious property, specifically the global headquarters for the Chabad-Lubavitch movement in Crown Heights, Brooklyn.
